name: Pair Dive
description: Drop both shoulders forward in a paired lean and fall onto the target with the weight of two.

name: Pinion Cover
description: Cross the forearms over the head and chest so the sleeves spread like folded wings.

name: Updraft Hop
description: Hop upward on both feet at once to clear a low sweep and land poised.

name: Matched Descent
description: Fall onto the target with fist and knee together in matched strokes from a short rise.

name: Plume Mend
description: Smooth warm qi over bruised flesh of yourself or an ally like a bird smoothing its feathers.

name: Talon Check
description: Catch the foe's striking arm between both hands and wrench it off its line.

name: Pinion Armor
description: Raise the hardened hide in layered plates along the arms and back that turn blows like pinion feathers.

name: Hawk-Pair Stoop
description: Rise on a gathered leap and fall with both shoulders onto the same point of the foe.

name: Skyfall Frame
description: Fall from a great height with the frame armored and let the blow break the ground around the foe.

name: Hawk Unity
description: School blow in which two plunging strokes land as one and the armored hide holds through the landing.

name: Judge's Brow
description: Furrow the brow and read the foe's stance for the hurt it hides and the blow it favours.

name: Seated Stance
description: Take a low wide seated stance and hold it under a pushing weight.

name: Rule Stroke
description: Bring the edge of the hand down in one fixed arc onto the target's collarbone.

name: Appeal Step
description: Step round a blow on a measured arc and leave the shoulder turned toward the foe.

name: Gavel Fist
description: Bring the heel of the fist down once on the foe's guard and break it with the settled weight.

name: Clemency Mend
description: Lay a calm hand on a hurt of yourself or an ally and let warm qi close it.

name: Sentence Cleanse
description: Pronounce the poison gone and drive it from the blood of yourself or an ally with firm qi.

name: Seat of Weight
description: Take the seat of judgement in the stance and let the whole frame bear any push laid upon it.

name: Pinning Decree
description: Pin the foe under a pressing arm and weight until it yields to the sentence.

name: Doom Gavel
description: Raise the fist overhead and bring it down in a judgement blow that cracks guard and armor alike.

name: Verdict of Mass
description: School blow in which the settled frame delivers one weighed stroke that ends the exchange.

name: Left Stream
description: Run qi down the left arm and throw a flowing blow that does not stop at the target.

name: Right Stream
description: Run qi down the right arm and let it pour into a guard that parts a blow.

name: Banking Step
description: Lean into a curving step as a river leans round a bend and gain speed from it.

name: Source Spring
description: Let a thin steady stream of qi seep into a wound of yourself or an ally until it stops hurting.

name: Swirling Guard
description: Turn the arms round a blow like a whirlpool and pull it past the body.

name: Joining Blow
description: Strike with both arms so the two flows of force meet at the target.

name: Silt Wash
description: Wash poison and sluggish humours out of the blood of yourself or an ally in a steady flow.

name: Rejoining Flow
description: Return spent qi from the guard arm to the striking arm so each blow draws on full strength.

name: Confluence Fist
description: Drive both flows of qi through one fist so the blow punches through plate and flesh.

name: Knitting Current
description: Pour the second stream into a badly wounded ally or yourself and drive the damage back.

name: Great Meeting
description: Bring the two flows together in the chest and release them in one blow that bursts over the foe.

name: Twin Sunder
description: School blow in which one stream strikes and the other mends the body of the striker as the blow lands.

name: Dive Brace
description: Tuck the chin and tense the shoulders to land from a drop without harm.

name: Descent Fist
description: Throw a fist in a falling arc from above the target's brow line.

name: Steady Run
description: Run light along a narrow line without a stumble and without breaking the pace.

name: Hide Gloss
description: Gloss the hide with a layer of qi that hardens it and warms the muscles beneath.

name: Falling Elbow
description: Drop from a leap and bring the elbow onto the top of the foe's shoulder.

name: Wingbeat Recovery
description: Beat the arms slowly like a hawk catching its breath and let the hurt of the dive ease.

name: Armored Plunge
description: Dive with the hide hardened to the full and take any blow met in the air without slowing.

name: Plate Mantle
description: Raise a mantle of overlapping hide plates that covers the back and arms against every cut.

name: Ruin Stoop
description: Dive from the height of a leap and land with the armored frame so the earth breaks around the foe.

name: Unbreakable Descent
description: School blow of the armored dive that crushes the foe and cannot be turned or broken on the way down.

name: Core Beat
description: Feel the Core beat once in the chest and let each beat push strength into the limbs.

name: Soaring Fist
description: Rise on the Core's strength and throw a fist from the top of the rise.

name: High Glide
description: Leap and hold the body flat in the air so the glide covers a long distance.

name: Heart Guard
description: Pack the chest with Core qi so the heart and lungs shrug off a blow.

name: Core Knitting
description: Spread Core warmth through the body of yourself or an ally and close deep hurts.

name: Updraft Strike
description: Rise on a surge of Core qi and strike the foe from above in the same motion.

name: Rot Scorching
description: Burn curse and rot from the body of yourself or an ally with the fierce heat of the Core.

name: Apex Armor
description: Wrap the frame in Core qi at its highest pitch so it turns the heaviest cut.

name: Zenith Drop
description: Hold the top of the leap for a breath and fall with the full weight of a Core.

name: Falling Star Body
description: Arrive on the foe like a falling star with the frame as the weight and a ring of shock around it.

name: Highest Plummet
description: School blow from the very top of the soar where the Core's weight lands in one stroke.

name: Pledged Lean
description: Lean into the wind on a sworn line and hold the line against the buffet.

name: Wind Elbow
description: Throw the elbow with the wind and let its push add speed to the strike.

name: Pledge Stride
description: Take a long step into the wind and hold the pledge to arrive.

name: Draught Slip
description: Ride the gust round the edge of a blow and leave the foe striking air.

name: Wind Fist
description: Throw a fist that carries the push of the wind behind the knuckles.

name: Chill Rub
description: Rub warmth into a chilled limb of yourself or an ally until the blood runs again.

name: Gale Stance
description: Stand in a stance that turns even a gale into a pressure the frame can bear.

name: Rolling Gust
description: Spin into the foe on a rolling gust and throw its balance off with the turn.

name: Storm Reckoning
description: Gather the wind into the frame and loose it in a blow that scatters those about the foe.

name: Wind-Driven Mass
description: School blow in which the wind throws the whole frame forward and the blow carries on past the foe.

name: Narrow Footing
description: Plant the feet along a narrow line and hold the frame still against any push.

name: Clasped Hammer
description: Swing the clasped hands down in one honest blow with nothing held back.

name: Long Pace
description: Cover ground in long even paces that keep the breath steady.

name: Broad Sensing
description: Turn the senses outward and feel the position of every body in the open space about you.

name: Falling Guard
description: Drop the guard from high to low as a blow comes and turn it down along the leg.

name: Charging Heel
description: Run in and plant the heel hard on the foe's foot before the blow follows.

name: Slow Rest
description: Lie back for a breath and let the open air and slow qi mend the worn body of yourself or an ally.

name: Steadfast Axis
description: Hold a single bearing against every push until the foe tires and falls away.

name: Hammering Run
description: Run at the foe with the weight low and strike at the end of the run with all of it.

name: Stampede Frame
description: Rush forward as a charging herd with the single frame and throw the foe from its footing.

name: Windward Onslaught
description: School charge that crosses the open ground with the wind behind it and ends in one unstoppable blow.

name: Bare Chest
description: Open the coat and meet a blow on the bare chest with qi packed behind it.

name: Honest Jab
description: Throw a straight jab with no feint and no flourish.

name: Candid Step
description: Step forward in full sight and show the foe where you are going.

name: Candour Breath
description: Breathe aloud and openly so every muscle takes up the held qi without cover.

name: Unshielded Reply
description: Take a blow on the open frame and answer it in the same motion.

name: Oath Salve
description: Swear to the hurt of yourself or an ally that it will mend and press warm qi into it.

name: Blunt Truth
description: Deliver a single blunt blow that says all that is needed and needs no second.

name: Burden Lifting
description: Lift the weight of a binding or curse from the limbs of yourself or an ally with open qi.

name: Truthful Frame
description: Stand wholly open with the frame full of qi and take whatever comes without a gap.

name: Open Thunder
description: Hold all the held qi in the open frame and strike once with a crack heard across the field.

name: Naked Wrath
description: Throw all cover aside and strike with the whole frame so the ground itself splits.

name: Open Frame Verdict
description: School blow of the open frame that takes the foe's last strike on the chest and ends the matter.

name: Axis Fix
description: Take a bearing from the pressure on the soles and the push of the air.

name: Fixed Fist
description: Throw a fist along the chosen bearing and let nothing turn it aside.

name: Rooted Shove
description: Shove with the root deep and the weight forward until the foe is moved.

name: Breathhide
description: Harden the skin with a steady outward breath that blunts the beating of the wind.

name: Straight Advance
description: Advance on the fixed bearing and strike straight through whatever stands on it.

name: Wind Ease
description: Let a slow cool wind of qi pass over the hurt of yourself or an ally and take the pain.

name: Never Turning
description: Face the foe on one bearing and refuse to turn from it however it strikes.

name: Always Arriving
description: Cross the gap along the bearing in a rush that ends in a blow before the foe can respond.

name: Windhammer
description: Draw the long wind into the arm and drop it as a single immense hammer upon the foe.

name: Unturned Judgement
description: School blow along the held bearing that nothing diverts and that reaches the foe wherever it stands.

name: Oath Foot
description: Plant the foot on the sworn spot and let no push move it.

name: Beyond Fist
description: Throw a fist aimed past the target so the force carries on through it.

name: Wind-Led Pace
description: Let the wind choose the pace and keep time with it.

name: Steady Core
description: Hold the Core steady under strain so strength flows to the limbs without surge or dip.

name: Vowed Frame
description: Meet the blow with the pledge spoken and the Core packing the frame behind it.

name: Vow Mending
description: Speak the oath over the hurt of yourself or an ally and let Core qi make it good.

name: Breaking Vow
description: Break the hold of a binding or curse on yourself or an ally with the force of the Core.

name: Outlasting Frame
description: Make the frame a thing the wind cannot wear down by holding Core qi in every limb.

name: Final Pledge
description: Gather the pledge into a single great blow that costs everything and lands once.

name: Vow Bursting
description: Burst the held vow outward from the Core and shake every foe within reach.

name: Oath Past Wind
description: School blow in which the oath carries the Core's force past the wind and through any guard.
